titolo: OpenAI launches GPT‑6 Cyber, a cybersecurity‑focused AI model
descr: OpenAI unveils GPT‑6 Cyber, designed to locate vulnerabilities and suggest fixes while staying within authorized scope.
paragrafi: OpenAI announced GPT‑6 Cyber, a new AI model aimed at cybersecurity tasks.
The model is trained to identify exploitable vulnerabilities and generate remediation steps.
OpenAI emphasizes that GPT‑6 Cyber is programmed to operate only within authorized boundaries.
The release follows a wave of AI model launches, with free chat models like Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 leading recent rankings.
perche: For security teams, GPT‑6 Cyber offers a specialized tool that can automate vulnerability discovery while respecting scope limits. Users seeking free or locally hosted alternatives can still rely on top‑ranked models such as Kimi K3 or GLM-5.3, which dominate current free chat model leaderboards.
